review_description: Quoting process was easy. Best price compared to other local companies and great install team.

From the initial recommendation through proposal & installation, this company has communicated effectively. Their price was very competitive but not a major determining factor in our decision. We could have easily gone with a more elaborate (and costly) system but their sales representative explained what little advantage that would give us considering our circumstances & location. I had an issue with their sub contractor installing a new main switch of insignificant value & charging $200 but Greenlight were most understanding & resolved the issue to my satisfaction. We were advised of installation dates well in advance & received clear communication with each step of the process.
A pleasure to deal withReally competitive price

Research process was hard but made easier by SolarQuotes site with all the information available. The sales process with the preferred supplier was easy, effective, prompt and they were responsive to all my questions. What was promised was delivered and installed. The installation was seamless except for a storm which meant that installers had to come back next day and finish. No problems for them. This really reflected well on the company. Recommend them highly. Some additional costs increased the total costs such as inverter had to be placed in garage or had to have a awning as it was facing west (govt requirement). That meant extra cabling  to garage. Inverter placement was not made clear initially but after questioning, based on information read I was able to understand the cost involved.
Greenlight Energy Solutions offered highly rated brands at the same price as other companies. Outstanding service and products.

Found these guys at the home show. They called & arranged an onsite quote for a 6.6 kw system.I went with this company because of their honesty & they were designing a system that would suit my needs.I actually called them about installing a battery & solar system to effectively neutralize my electricity bill.I was told that origin energy had a 21 cent feed in tariff & just a solar system producing enough surplus powerwould pay for the electricity I purchased as well as the daily charge. This option would be far cheaper than a battery system.I also need the new system to run along side of my old 2Kw systemA week later & the New 6.6 Kw system is running & I couldn't be happier as I earned $10 per day FIT for the first 2 days of operation.They were prompt & showed up when they said they would & didn't leave any mess.
Polite, Tidy and Punctual, quick to ask questions about any possible minor problems before they happen.
